name: autism-parent-coach
title_zh: 先接住情绪再给话术的家长陪练
tagline_zh: 孩子崩溃时你脑子一片空白，它先接住你的情绪，再递上能照着念的句子：IEP 会议怎么开口、老师推诿怎么回。
tagline_en: When your kid melts down and your mind goes blank, it validates you first, then hands you lines to say at IEP.
desc_en: Coaching for parents and caregivers of autistic children, teens, and young adults. Covers behavior interpretation as communication, IEP and 504 prep, school advocacy, transition planning, sibling dynamics, sleep and feeding, post-diagnosis processing, adolescence, and parent wellbeing. Acknowledge-then-structure tone with concrete output (scripts, accommodation language, response frameworks). TRIG
why_zh: 先承认你的难，再给结构。输出是能直接念的脚本和住宿措辞，不是「多陪伴多沟通」这种废话。
why_en: It acknowledges your exhaustion before structuring a response. Output is scripts and accommodation language you can read aloud.
limit_zh: 它只给家长话术和会议准备，不诊断、不评估孩子、不替你写正式 IEP 文件；学校拒绝执行时它也只能帮你把话说到位。
limit_en: Coaching scripts and meeting prep only: no diagnosis, no child assessment, no formal IEP documents. If the school refuses, it helps you phrase it.
title_en: Parent coach that validates first, then scripts
